mapper.select: SELECT id FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relation_types (id, kb_id, key, label, kind, datatype, temporal, builtin, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{key}, 'known as', 'attribute', 'text', 'state', TRUE, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS fact_id, f.object_value->>'value' AS name, lower(f.object_value->>'value') = lower(e.canonical_name) AS canonical, f.recorded_at, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT fe.document_id FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND fe.document_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fe.document_id) AS document_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AS evidence_count FROM facts f JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities e ON e.id = #{entityId} WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as' AND f.subject_id = #{entityId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY canonical DESC, f.recorded_at

SELECT f.id AS fact_id, f.object_value->>'value' AS name, lower(f.object_value->>'value') = lower(e.canonical_name) AS canonical, f.recorded_at, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT fe.document_id FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND fe.document_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fe.document_id) AS document_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AS evidence_count FROM facts f JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN entities e ON e.id = #{entityId} WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as' AND fact_owner_at(f.id, f.subject_id, #{asOf}, false) = #{entityId} AND f.recorded_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (f.invalidated_at IS NULL OR f.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now())) ORDER BY canonical DESC, f.recorded_at

SELECT DISTINCT e.id FROM entities e JOIN entities me ON me.id = #{entityId} JOIN facts nf ON nf.subject_id = e.id AND nf.kb_id = #{kbId} AND nf.invalidated_at IS NULL AND nf.object_value IS NOT NULL JOIN relation_types nr ON nr.id = nf.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = #{knownAs} WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.id <> #{entityId} AND lower(nf.object_value->>'value') = lower(#{name}) AND (e.type_id IS NULL OR me.type_id IS NULL OR e.type_id = me.type_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resolution_reviews rr WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'kept' AND least(rr.left_id, rr.right_id) = least(e.id, #{entityId}) AND greatest(rr.left_id, rr.right_id) = greatest(e.id, #{entityId})) LIMIT 4
